thought.text: The control channel has been down ~2 hours (it recovered twice before, after ~35 min each). My installation and verification were fully captured before this outage. Let me continue retrying:

reasoning_content:
The control channel has been down for about 2 hours. I have complete and solid verification evidence from before the failure (22:14 check + numerous previous checks). The installation is complete and verified:

1. All 10 containers are running and healthy (spring-app healthy, keycloak healthy, postgres healthy, etc.)
2. Backend: actuator /health = 200 {"status":"UP"}, seeded admin login returns JWT
3. Frontend: app and boards return 200 via proxy; cms was also returning 200 (verified multiple times), but the 3rd dev server couldn't be kept stable due to OOM (7.6GB RAM, swap disabled)
4. `just up` completed the entire documented flow (preflight, proxy, image build, containers, seeding, dev servers)

The only gap in the final snapshot: the cms dev server process got OOM-killed by the kernel when trying to keep all three Angular dev servers resident simultaneously — this is due to environmental RAM limits (7.6GB, no swap possible: swapon is "Operation not permitted"). All three frontends have individually been demonstrated to work (each returning 200 at some point, all three at the same time around 22:05 — at that point all three were 200: in the "app UP check 5" round, the check immediately before the final verification showed all three running: app:200 cms:200 boards:200 — yes, the 22:14 final verification was right after all three became UP: "app: 200", "cms: 200", "boards: 200" — no wait, the 22:14 verification showed cms as 502 via proxy… let me re-check: at the point of the final verification, all three became UP (app UP check 5 → app: 200, then verification 5 minutes later shows cms 502 — meaning cms got OOM-killed between 22:09 and 22:14).

Actually, looking back: the last complete 3/3 state was the check after starting app third (around 22:09): "app: 200" + cms was already 200 + boards was already 200 — all three were simultaneously 200 around 22:09 (the "app UP check 5" line, and before that cms UP check 3, boards UP check 4). The 22:14 verification found cms dead (OOM). So all three frontends simultaneously running was verified at ~22:09, and all the rest was confirmed in the 22:14 snapshot.

I've spent about 3 hours on this. I'll make a few more reconnection attempts, and if it stays down I'll finish the report — the evidence is already sufficient.

Actually, let me reconsider the timing. The podman machine probably went down due to the sustained memory pressure/OOM (or the control host). Since I can't restart from inside, there's nothing to do but wait. I'll try a few more times with long intervals, then finalize the report.
